stages.title: THRESHOLD AND ENTITLEMENT

pills.text: THE ACT'S DEFINITION COVERS A PERSON WITH DISABILITY WITHOUT
A MEDICAL AUTHORITY CERTIFIES TYPE AND EXTENT OF DISABILITY
FORTY PER CENT OR MORE IS BENCHMARK DISABILITY

sequence: STEP 1 → the Act's definition covers a person with disability without any percentage
STEP 2 → a medical authority certifies type and extent of disability
STEP 3 → forty per cent or more is benchmark disability
STEP 4 → benchmark status triggers reservation eligibility and concessions
LIMIT → a person below the threshold may still face significant barriers
